messages:
joel (eng-platform): thinking about adding a small 'priority_band' to the rerank response so downstream routers and the console can show urgency/cost tradeoffs. e.g. bucket scores into 0..3 instead of raw floats. thoughts?
anya (eng-runtime): curious — is this meant to replace normalized score or be orthogonal?
joel (eng-platform): orthogonal. keep raw score for ranking. priority_band would be advisory hint for routing/quotas and UI badges. reduces churn when we tweak model calibs.
kevin (product): +1 for UI friendliness. Can we guarantee stability across model versions though? dont want badge jumping for users.
maya (console): if it's stable-ish we can show a small badge and have a tooltip: "priority band from model vX — advisory". also want telemetry mapping to billing rows.
anya (eng-runtime): implementation caveats: if we compute band from raw score client-side vs server-side? prefer server to avoid client variance and to tie to model version.
joel (eng-platform): server-side, using a deterministic mapping published in model metadata. see proto sketch: ```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id":"c1","score":0.8732,"priority_band":2},
    {"id":"c2","score":0.121,"priority_band":0}
  ],
  "model_meta": {"name":"rerank-v3","priority_bands": [0.0, 0.2, 0.6, 0.9]}
}
```
kevin (product): that metadata helps. question: how does this affect quota accounting? do we charge differently for band 3 vs band 0?
joel (eng-platform): proposal: keep token/candidate accounting unchanged for now, but expose band in telemetry so billing experiments can run. long term we might offer a "high-priority" billing tier.
maya (console): console UX needs a rollout plan: default hide band for first 2 weeks, enable for teams on beta flag. add a filter to surface high-priority requests and tie to model version.
anya (eng-runtime): runtime: we can compute band at scoring time with almost zero cost. caveat: if we have multi-model fanout (exact + lightweight), we need consistent banding across candidates from different models. need canonicalization rules.
joel (eng-platform): on multi-model fanout, propose: band comes from the final aggregated ranker (post-merge) and we include per-candidate provenance: `origin_model` string. sample: ```json
{"candidates":[{"id":"c1","score":0.9,"priority_band":3,"origin_model":"light-embed-v2"}]}
```
kevin (product): provenance is key. also want a console toggle to color-code by origin_model for debugging.
maya (console): doable. will need mapping table in model registry to show human labels.
anya (eng-runtime): one more thing — backward compatibility: clients that ignore priority_band are fine. we should version the schema as 1.2 and add feature flag in response header `X-Rerank-Flags: priority_band=v1`
joel (eng-platform): agree. rollout plan: feature flag gated, canary to 5% for a week, gather telemetry on band distributions + UI feedback. create a dashboard: band counts, per-model distribution, per-tenant high-priority %.
kevin (product): please include a regression alert if band distribution shifts >10% vs baseline.
joel (eng-platform): noted. action items: 1) anya to add band calc + origin_model to runtime (PR by Thu). 2) maya to add console beta surfaces and telemetry rows (mockups by Wed). 3) joel to add model metadata schema and rollout playbook (draft by Fri).
anya (eng-runtime): starting work, will ping in thread when PR is ready :rocket:
maya (console): i'll sketch UI and share screenshots in #design later today :eyes:
rerank-bot: deploy scheduled: canary group creation at 2024-06-15T22:00Z (placeholder) :robot_face:
joel (eng-platform): thanks all — we'll sync tomorrow on the playbook. :thumbsup:
